answer: A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The dawn counter is kept in cipher and whisper makes public each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 27 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
